scope: local workerd relay with provider/auth simulated
observation: Fixture provider observed two messages and proof did not finish while waiting for another event. Root cause was not yet established; harness lacked per-step event/close timeouts. Next fixture uses an actual local Worker service-binding upgrade and bounded event waits.
